    5. Initializes a list `time` with -inf for each node, except the last node which is set to inf.
    6. Initializes a priority queue with a tuple (inf, N-1).
    7. While the queue is not empty, extracts the maximum element (tx, x) using `_heappop_max`.
    8. If `time[x]` is greater than `tx`, continues to the next iteration (bug is here).

    12. If `time[y]` is less than `ty`, updates `time[y]` to `ty` and pushes `(ty, y)` onto the queue using `_heappush_max`.
